Who We Are

Engineering Excellence. Authority Expertise. One Trusted Partner.

Megavolt Technical Services (Megavolt Technical Services Co. LLC) is a Dubai-based MEP engineering and authority approvals firm serving the UAE since 2020. We work on residential, commercial, and industrial projects — from single-villa DEWA approvals to warehouse power upgrades and MEP fit-outs.

We are a DEWA registered contractor and prepare submissions for DEWA, Dubai Municipality, Civil Defence, RTA and free zone authorities. We design, install and handle the approvals in one place.
